title: feat(platform-objects): the System Overview datasets carry synonyms and a description on their seven members

Fixes #34921

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi3ezPzTysQPDEjmVz
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：平台自带的“系统概览”五个数据集（用户、组织、会话、安装包、审计日志）里的七个指标/维度，现在都有了中英文同义词和一句业务定义；业务定义在 11 种语言包里都有翻译。
- **为什么改**：管理员问“有多少用户”/ "how many users" 时，问数工具只能靠指标名或当前语言的标签去匹配，平台自己的指标反而查不到；现在这些问法能直接命中 `user_count`。
- **风险与回滚**：只改元数据和语言包，不动 spec、规则和运行时代码；最坏情况是某个同义词选得不准，回滚就是还原 `system.datasets.ts` 和语言包这一个 PR。
- **先看**：① `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/dashboards/system.datasets.ts`（七组同义词，看措辞准不准、有没有两个指标抢同一个词）；② `packages/rest/src/system-overview-dataset-vocabulary.test.ts`（真实数据集走真实 `list_datasets` 的钉子）；③ `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.ts` 的 `datasets` 段。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/system-overview-dataset-vocabulary.test.ts`（需先构建 platform-objects），预期 8 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The five System Overview datasets (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/dashboards/system.datasets.ts`) gain ADR-0149 D1 vocabulary on all seven members:

| Dataset | Member | Synonyms (one authored array, never bundled) |
|---|---|---|
| `sys_user_metrics` | measure `user_count` | 用户, 用户数, 用户数量, 用户总数, 有多少用户, users, user count, number of users, total users, how many users |
| `sys_organization_metrics` | measure `org_count` | 组织, 组织数, 组织数量, 组织总数, 有多少组织, organizations, orgs, organization count, number of organizations, how many organizations |
| `sys_session_metrics` | measure `session_count` | 会话, 会话数, 会话数量, 登录会话, 有多少会话, sessions, session count, number of sessions, login sessions, how many sessions |
| `sys_package_installation_metrics` | measure `package_count` | 已安装的包, 安装的包数, 包安装数, 装了多少包, installations, installed packages, package installations, package count, number of installed packages, how many packages are installed |
| `sys_audit_log_metrics` | dimension `action` | 操作类型, 动作, 审计动作, action type, operation, audit action |
| `sys_audit_log_metrics` | dimension `user_id` | 操作人, 操作者, 执行人, 操作用户, actor, performed by, acting user |
| `sys_audit_log_metrics` | measure `event_count` | 事件, 事件数, 审计事件, 审计事件数, 审计日志条数, 有多少审计事件, events, event count, audit events, audit log entries, how many audit events |

Each member also gets a one-sentence `description`. That text is display copy, so it has a bundle entry at `datasets.NAME.{measures,dimensions}.MEMBER.description` in all eleven Setup bundle locales (en mirrors the source verbatim; zh-CN, zh-Hant, ja-JP, ko, es-ES, fr, pt-BR, de, ru and ar are hand-translated, as the existing `datasets.*.label` rows are). Each translated locale records the new paths' source digests in its hand-maintained `LOCALE.source-hashes.ts`, written the same way the label rows were (`collectSourceHashes(en)`; the existing label digests reproduce byte-for-byte). No `*.generated.ts` file changes, and no generator output moves.

**How the matcher treats these words.** `matchDatasetTerms` (service-analytics) compares a term with a member's name, label and synonyms by EQUALITY after `normalizeDatasetTerm`. It never matches a substring or a single word inside a phrase. So a multi-word term such as "how many users" resolves only where a member writes that exact phrase as one synonym. I chose to write the administrator's phrasing (`how many users`, `有多少用户`) as synonyms, plus the term forms a model lifts from a question (`user count`, `用户数`). A longer question with no exact hit, such as "how many users do we have", still gets only near `candidates` (containment, two code points or more), which means a clarifying question. That behaviour is unchanged.

**Collisions.** Within one dataset, the schema's vocabulary refinement judges collisions (full `DatasetSchema.safeParse` is green for all five). Across the five datasets, no synonym is a word of another *measure* in any locale, and a new test pins that. The one cross-member equality is 「用户」: it is a `user_count` synonym and also the existing zh-CN label of the `user_id` dimension. In zh-CN the two labels already met before this PR. A dimension match picks no number, so the word still answers with `user_count`. In other locales the synonym adds the only match.

The other language's bare label is listed on purpose (`users` beside 「用户」). The label a caller is matched against is the one served in the caller's locale, so under zh-CN the English label `Users` is not a match target.

No spec, schema, protocol or vocabulary-rule change. The rule's module note ("It answers to no synonym unless its source writes one") stays true; the source now writes them.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/system-overview-dataset-vocabulary.test.ts` (new) puts the pin where these datasets meet the dataset tools without new wiring: `@objectstack/rest` already depends on both `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@objectstack/service-analytics`. It feeds the REAL datasets, localized by the REAL Setup bundle through `translateDataset`, to the REAL `list_datasets` of an `AnalyticsServicePlugin`-booted service. The objects behind the datasets are declaration doubles. Under `en` and `zh-CN`:
  - `terms: ['用户数']` matches exactly `sys_user_metrics.measures.user_count`, on `synonym`, and has no `candidates`;
  - `terms: ['how many users']` matches the same member the same way;
  - the control `terms: ['营收', 'revenue']` matches nothing and has no `candidates`;
  - under zh-CN, the catalogue lists `user_count`'s description from the bundle.
- `system-overview-dataset-translations.test.ts` gains a top-level `describe` in the existing harness file:
  - all seven members declare a Chinese and an English synonym and a description;
  - each dataset survives a full parse;
  - no synonym is another measure's word in any locale;
  - the en bundle copies each description verbatim;
  - no translated locale serves the English description.

<details><summary>Ablation: drop user_count's synonyms, the pin goes red</summary>

The ablation ran through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which deleted the `user_count` `synonyms` array. Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects build`, then `node scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/platform-objects "total users" --absent` (exit 0: the marker is gone from `dist/`).

```
MUTANT test exit=1
 × en: 「用户数」 resolves to user_count alone, by its declared synonym
 × en: "how many users" resolves to user_count alone, by its declared synonym
 × zh-CN: 「用户数」 resolves to user_count alone, by its declared synonym
 × zh-CN: "how many users" resolves to user_count alone, by its declared synonym
 Tests  4 failed | 4 passed (8)
```

The 4 that stayed green are the listing, the two controls and the description case, which is what you would expect.

Restore: `ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (b3d478488ce5) and git diff HEAD is empty`. After a rebuild the preflight found the marker present in 4 built files with a clean tree, and the suite went back to `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **i18n baseline moved by 0.** `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json` holds `packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts: 0` before and after, and `node scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs` reports `OK (14 config(s), 423 baselined untranslated string(s), none new)`. The extract config declares no `datasets`, so the ratchet's population does not include these rows in either direction. The new strings are held instead by the translation test above (every locale translated, en verbatim).
- The synonyms are Simplified Chinese and English only. `normalizeDatasetTerm` does not fold Traditional to Simplified, so a zh-Hant administrator typing 「使用者數」 matches only the zh-Hant label 「使用者」, and only in that locale. This is noted here, not filed.
- `sys_package_installation` is cloud-only. Where the object is absent, its dataset is left out of `list_datasets`, and the synonyms are harmless there.
